retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist portrait where a central figure's anatomy merges with natural landscapes, featuring vibrant airbrushed gradients and elemental transformations.

recipe.visualDefinition: A profile view of a man with a large afro that dominates the upper frame, where his breath transforms into a flowing volcanic eruption and the back of his head dissolves into a lush, rocky mountain landscape with trees.
coreVisualRelationships: Human profile as a container for elemental forces
Contrast between the dark, textured afro and the bright, neon volcanic fire
Seamless transition from skin tones to rocky cliff textures
Horizontal flow of breath-fire balancing the verticality of the mountain-head
coreInvariants: Landscape integrated into the back of the head/neck

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait occupying the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eye and mouth area of the central figure, serving as the origin point for the volcanic action.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Leading from the right (face) to the left (fire) and then upward into the massive afro.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with texture and color.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purples and blacks in the hair and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Neon pinks, oranges, and yellows in the volcanic fire.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lush greens and earthy browns in the mountain landscape.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with dramatic value shifts from deep shadows to glowing highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative script to contrast the complex, textured illustration.
graphicDevices: Small circular logo in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s casual but elegant hand-drawn feel
Matches the high-contrast formal cursive look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed surrealist painting of a man's profile where his breath is a pink and orange volcano and the back of his head is a mountain with trees, under a massive dark afro.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of elegant, slanted orange script in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the fire emerging directly from the mouth?
Does the landscape blend naturally into the head?
Is the afro large and textured?
Is the color palette vibrant and psychedelic?

adjustableVariables: Density of the forest on the head
mustRedesign: Do not replicate exact brand logos
Ensure the face is a generic surrealist representation

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of organic and human forms
Glow effect on the volcanic elements
avoid: Disjointed elements that don't flow together

postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth gradients in the airbrushing
Verify the profile silhouette is clear
Ensure the script is legible against the dark hair
Confirm the surrealist 'landscape-head' concept is executed
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Portrait + [Elemental Force] Breath + [Natural Environment] Back-of-Head + 70s Airbrush Style
